links.outcome: Model AUC drift over time due to documentation changes
links.effect: AUC decreased from 0.78 in 2022 to 0.70 in 2023 and 0.67 in 2024; discharge summaries doubled in length; 13% AUC decline.
links.quote: Performance was strongest in the first year; AUC decreased from 0.78 in 2022 to 0.70 in 2023 and 0.67 in 2024.

links.outcome: Sensitivity maintained after monthly dynamic recalibration of threshold despite drift
links.effect: Monthly threshold recalibration using prior 6 months; calibrated model achieved sensitivity 78.6% and specificity 50.2% despite AUC decline.
links.quote: Despite a temporal trend in both yearly and monthly prediction scores ( Figures 2 C, 2 D), the calibrated model demonstrated resilience to evolving documentation patterns, achieving a sensitivity and specificity of 78.6% and 50.2%.

links.outcome: Temporal validation performance on later unseen cohort
links.effect: Strict temporal split with no leakage; AUC 0.71 overall in test cohort but degraded over time, from 0.78 to 0.67.
links.quote: All admissions before June 2021 were assigned to training, calibration, and model selection to ensure no data leakage from the original NYUTron training set.
